description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the COD (Cash on Delivery) payment method extension in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It defines the class 'COD' which extends the base Model class, and implements a method 'getMethods' to retrieve available payment options based on certain conditions such as geographic zone and shipping/subscription status.
